crossRefs.note: But he lingered; and the men grabbed his hand, his wife’s hand, and his two daughters’ hands, Yahweh being merciful to…

translations.web: for if we hadn’t delayed, surely we would have returned a second time by now.”
translations.bsb: If we had not delayed, we could have come and gone twice by now.”
translations.kjv: For except we had lingered, surely now we had returned this second time.
translations.asv: for except we had lingered, surely we had now returned a second time.
